tone.unit: articulation-specific high-pass and broad resonant color

decay.unit: CH hold 9-90ms and tau 6-60ms; OH tau 35-875ms

shape.unit: inharmonic spread, transient contour and upper-half ring blend

choke.unit: 0 exactly off; above 0 exponential release tau 0.25ms*400^(1-value)

choke_gate.unit: rising-edge external open-hat choke, creates no closed hit

event_semantics.synthesis_latching: Metal/Tone/Decay/Shape/Drive/Pitch/Velocity latch separately on the corresponding CH or OH onset. CH locks never revoice a ringing OH.
event_semantics.note_off: No choking or envelope release; both articulations are one-shot.
event_semantics.choke: A CH onset or external choke edge samples Choke and starts/updates a monotonic accumulated release. Choke=0 is exact off. A later CH cannot reset release progress. New OH clears prior choke progress.
event_semantics.priority: External choke wins if simultaneous with an OH trigger. CH plus external choke still produces the CH.
event_semantics.persistent_state: Oscillators, noise and filters keep running; no phase reset at onset. One paired kernel can carry one CH and one OH envelope concurrently.
event_semantics.host_routing: Use a paired kernel per intended choke group, or broadcast explicit choke_gate edges to ringing open-hat instances. Independent per-note allocation alone does not implement cross-voice choking.
event_semantics.host_validation: Send articulation exactly 0 or 1 and gates exactly 0/1. Apply locks before computing the trigger sample. A computed low sample is required between rising edges. Validate finite/range values in the adapter.

migration: Breaking sound/ABI revision: v1 pitch_hz was a ratio despite its label; v2 explicitly calls it pitch_ratio. Do not silently replace v1 project sound identities or reinterpret old presets as v2. Source folder and version must both be pinned.
reference: Measured original TR-808 direct-output recordings, Synthmania unit 209265. Mutant Hi-Hats is a control/interaction lead only, not measured hardware parity.
samples: No runtime samples, files, network, or external audio dependencies.
